sentimento.text1: The presidential book has accumulated USD 142.61M and the price on this page is from the confirmed reading of 03/Sep, 23:45 BRT (04/Sep, 02:45 UTC). ⭐ [DATAFOLHA](/en/glossary#datafolha) CAME OUT AROUND 20:20 and is the third national poll in 48 hours, after Genial/[Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 02/Sep and PoderData earlier this same Thursday.
sentimento.text2: ⭐ ALL THREE DISAGREE ON THE SIGN OF THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) between the top two: Genial/Quaest of 02/Sep put the leader ahead by 42% to 41%, PoderData of 03/Sep put the runner-up ahead by 45% to 44%, and Datafolha of 03/Sep puts the leader ahead by 46% to 44%. All three margins are 1 or 2 points and all three houses declare a margin of error of 2pp, so none of them asserts a lead outside the margin. The panel records all three and does not choose between them.
sentimento.text3: In the price, a single name out of the presidential book's nineteen moved since the 17:28 reading: the runner-up, up 0.35pp to 42.85%. The leader is still at 54.50% and has not moved for more than eight hours. The gap between the two fell to 11.65pp, against 12.00pp at 17:28, 14.85pp on 02/Sep and 16.55pp on 01/Sep, narrowing across four consecutive readings.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 42.85% (vol USD 9.64M accumulated), confirmed reading of 03/Sep, 23:45 BRT (04/Sep, 02:45 UTC), up 0.35pp and the only move in the book over the interval. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he gave up 2.00pp and stands at 83.50% (vol USD 527 thousand). the Datafolha poll of 03/Sep (BR-03669/2026, field 01 to 03/Sep, n=2,002, margin of 2pp) gives him 32% in the scenario with Pablo Marçal and 33% in the one without, the same figures as the house's round of 21/Aug, and 44% in a second round in which the leader has 46%. He used the crisis at the Supreme Court to try to build momentum for the 7 September rally, according to Folha de S.Paulo.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 54.50% (vol USD 9.67M accumulated), confirmed reading of 03/Sep, 23:45 BRT (04/Sep, 02:45 UTC), unchanged since the 15:22 reading. In the first-round runner-up contract he rose 1.80pp and stands at 10.50% (vol USD 439 thousand). Datafolha gives him 39% and 38% across the two first-round scenarios, and he wins the three second-round pairings with published figures. ⚠️ BUT THE GAP IN THE MAIN PAIRING HALVED WITHIN THE HOUSE ITSELF: 46% to 44%, against 47% to 43% on 21/Aug. Government approval from the same house: 45% approve and 51% disapprove.
sentimento.terceiraVia: ⭐ DATAFOLHA IS THE FOURTH TOP-TIER HOUSE TO MEASURE AUGUSTO CURY'S JUMP AND THE ONLY ONE THAT LEAVES HIM BELOW DOUBLE DIGITS: 7% in the scenario with Marçal and 8% in the one without, against 2% in the house's own round of 21/Aug. The other four put him in double digits: BTG/Nexus 11% on 31/Aug, Real Time Big Data 11% on 01/Sep, Genial/Quaest 10% on 02/Sep and PoderData 10% on 03/Sep. The direction is the same across all five; the level differs by three to four points. In the price he gave up 0.10pp in the winner contract, to 1.25% (vol USD 3.69M), and rose 3.60pp in the first-round third-place contract, to 59.50% (vol USD 114 thousand). ⚠️ Renan Santos had the panel's largest fall in this reading, 4.50pp in the third-place contract, to 22.00% (vol USD 269 thousand), and the gap between the two in that market went from 29.40pp to 37.50pp.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of 03/Sep, 23:45 BRT (04/Sep, 02:45 UTC). AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, taken eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20 point. ⚠️ THIS ROUND PUBLISHES NO NEW PRICE FOR THE [SUPREME COURT](/en/glossary#stf) IMPEACHMENT CONTRACT, and its last confirmed reading is the 03/Sep one at 17:28, at 7.40%. It also publishes no new price for Ronaldo Caiado, Pablo Marçal and Romeu Zema in the winner contract, because all three sit below the 0.5% floor. The presidential book has accumulated USD 142.61M.

inss.text1: THE [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) CEREMONY WAS THIS THURSDAY, at 3pm at the Planalto Palace, and what this round adds is the DEFINITION the government uses. According to the social security minister, quoted by Metrópoles: the queue counts as cleared when fewer people are waiting than the number who filed requests the previous month, and that happened in August 2026.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT FALLS OUTSIDE THAT COUNT HAS A NUMBER. Requests running more than 45 days late totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million in January, a fall of 86%. Open applications dropped to 1.2 million, against roughly 3 million at the start of the year, a fall of 59%. Average review time stands at 35 days. Figures from Metrópoles and Poder360.
inss.text3: 📌 THIS PAGE'S 15:22 READING DESCRIBED THE CRITERION DIFFERENTLY, as an application inside the legal review deadline, and the definition above is the one the minister himself gave. The panel swaps its wording for the minister's, with attribution, and does not arbitrate between the two. On the same Thursday the lower house approved a provisional measure to speed up INSS benefit reviews, according to Metrópoles.
inss.text4: The case remains open and unresolved. The distinction the panel has kept from the start still holds: the effect on the government's approval rating is one thing, the effect on voting intention is another, and the two do not add up.
inss.impactoLula: The structured reading of government approval is still the Genial/Quaest poll of 02/Sep, with a field window of 30/Aug to 01/Sep: 45% approve and 48% disapprove, with 7% giving no answer. The PoderData poll of 03/Sep did not publish government approval in the table that was checked. In first-round voting intention PoderData puts the president at 37%, the same figure as the Quaest poll the day before.
inss.impactoGestao: Within Quaest itself the picture is one of stillness. On 05/Aug it was 48% approval against 47% disapproval, on 14/Aug 46% against 48% and on 02/Sep 45% against 48%. Disapproval repeats the same figure for the house's third round running. On the performance scale, 35% excellent or good, 25% fair and 37% poor or very poor, against 36%, 25% and 37% on 14/Aug. The panel deliberately keeps one house per block, so as not to add up yardsticks from different institutes.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures is narrow, and it is worth recording as such: in two hours the news agenda did not change, and a single contract in the presidential book moved. The panel does not attribute that move to the INSS ceremony or to the Supreme Court news, and records that it came with about USD 5.8 thousand of new business.

bancoMaster.text1: TODAY'S NEW PLEA DEAL IS STILL THE ONE WITH ANTONIO CARLOS FREIXO JÚNIOR, owner of Entre Investimentos, the first cooperation deal tied directly to the Dark Horse case, according to Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo. ⚠️ THE AGREEMENT IS CLOSED AND NOT YET RATIFIED: the next step is sending it to the reporting justice.
bancoMaster.text2: THE REAG FOUNDER'S PLEA DEAL, João Carlos Mansur's, is from 2 September and ADVANCED at the court this Thursday, according to Metrópoles. It was signed by the Prosecutor General's Office and sent to Justice André Mendonça's chambers, and the proposal had been submitted on 26 August. Mendonça still has to schedule a hearing and decide whether to ratify it, and without ratification the agreement does not count as evidence.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ AND THERE ARE TWO ACCOUNTS OF PRESSURE, BOTH ON THE RECORD. Daniel Vorcaro said in his testimony that he was pressured not to implicate a [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) director and members of the government, according to Gazeta do Povo, and before that that he received threats while negotiating the plea deal, according to O Globo. The Prosecutor General's Office asked on 02/Sep for that complaint to be SHELVED, saying he presented no evidence, according to Folha de S.Paulo, O Globo and G1. The panel records both and does not arbitrate.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The chronology is the information, and it has seven distinct dates: the meeting between the justice and the businessman is from 14 March 2025; the messages are from 16 November 2025; the arrest is from 17 November 2025; the Federal Police report was delivered on 27 August 2026, the same day as the testimony taken without the Federal Police; secrecy was lifted on 1 September; the Reag founder's plea deal was signed on 2 September and went for ratification; and the plea deal with the businessman tied to Dark Horse was closed on 3 September. ⚠️ NEITHER PLEA DEAL HAS BEEN RATIFIED. And what has not happened yet is still scheduled: Mendonça's report on Moraes is expected on 7 or 8 September, according to Poder360.

stf.toffoli: No new individual action on 03/Sep. He remains a target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos, alongside Moraes, according to G1 and Poder360.
stf.moraes: ⭐ HE IS THE ONE WHO ACTED, AND IT IS THE HARSHEST ACT IN THE SERIES. He asked Edson Fachin to investigate André Mendonça in the fake news inquiry, based on a report he himself commissioned from the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) without the court presidency's approval, according to Gazeta do Povo and O Globo. Estadão records the report as internal and without evidentiary value. Marina Silva argued that he should step aside from the court, according to Metrópoles.
stf.gilmar: He proposed removing Federal Police officers from Supreme Court chambers, according to Folha de S.Paulo and Poder360. Federal Police officers said he is diverting attention from the court's real problems, according to Gazeta do Povo.
stf.dino: No new individual action captured on 03/Sep.
stf.mendonca: He became the target of the investigation request made by Moraes. He produced tailor's receipts to rebut the suspicion of a gift from Daniel Vorcaro, according to Gazeta do Povo, and has five working days to respond. His report on Moraes is still expected on 7 or 8 September.
stf.nexo: ⭐ THE CRISIS MOVED FROM REACTION TO ACTION, AND BETWEEN THE JUSTICES THEMSELVES. Edson Fachin gave five working days to Moraes, Mendonça, prosecutor general Paulo Gonet and the Federal Police director general to provide information, according to G1, VEJA and Folha de S.Paulo, and postponed to the second half of September the full court session on the case, according to Poder360. The procedure was opened after the Prosecutor General's Office asked for the dismissal of the petition holding the Federal Police material on officials named in the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) investigation.
stf.analise: ⚠️ THIS ROUND PUBLISHES NO NEW PRICE FOR THE CONTRACT on a Supreme Court justice leaving through impeachment before 2027. The last confirmed reading is the 03/Sep one at 17:28, at 7.40% (vol USD 87 thousand), and that is the one the page keeps. 📌 THE CONTRAST CLOSES THE DAY: the crisis produced this Thursday the harshest act in the series, with one justice asking for another to be investigated, and this is the only contract on the panel with no new reading to publish. It is also the smallest book on the panel, with accumulated volume that does not exceed USD 87 thousand, and the house rule always applies here: a price that moves a lot on very little money does not describe a shift in expectations of the same size. The contract measures a justice leaving, not whether the investigation goes anywhere nor whether the Senate takes up the request.
